annotation.title_clean: Consultation on the draft guidelines on transparency obligations under the AI Act
annotation.title_en: Consultation on the draft guidelines on transparency obligations under the AI Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology
annotation.summary_en: European Commission consultation page (8 May–3 June 2026) seeking feedback on draft guidelines clarifying Article 50 AI Act transparency obligations for interactive and generative AI, deep fakes and emotion recognition. Complements a voluntary Code of Practice on marking and labelling AI-generated content. Rules apply from 2 August 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Draft guidelines clarify Article 50 AI Act transparency obligations
Providers must inform users they interact with AI and apply machine-readable marks to generated content
Deployers must disclose deep fakes and AI-generated public-interest publications
Deployers must inform people exposed to emotion recognition or biometric categorisation
Voluntary Code of Practice on AI-generated content transparency being finalised in parallel; rules apply 2 August 2026
